_about: What MES prints for three identity items, per CAN-C module, from MES's own log files on disk (read-only). did_hint: the standard UDS identifier that holds the item where CUORE has a recorded reply that matches MES; null where no source on file names the DID. blank = MES printed the label with no value. unknown = no real (non-simulation) MES log on disk shows the item. Nothing here is a request.

items.label: ECU ISO code
items.did_note: No source on file names the DID that holds this; CUORE has not asked for it.

items.label: Hardware version
items.did_note: UDS identifier F193 (supplier hardware version). One recorded CUORE reply, TCM, equals MES.

items.label: Homologation number
items.did_note: No source on file names the DID that holds this; CUORE has not asked for it.
